Triage: `needs-user-decision`, `domain:spec`, Feature —— 排序声明位是契约形状提案(spec 面新增键 或 语义继承规则),人工地板。维护者亲filed,复现完整(17.2.0 真机)。姊妹卡 objectui#5795(组件侧同一现象)已并挂 `pm:blocked` 指向本卡 —— 单一派发入口在此。

<!-- os-decision-facets -->
四维分析(中文):
- **实际业务需求** — 真实业务数据(检查项 seq_no)在派生相关列表里按记录 id 兜底序渲染,对用户等于随机序;复现在维护者自己的应用上,拉动为实。
- **项目长远合理性** — 17.0.0 移除 `view.form.defaultSort` 时的迁移说明(「相关列表按子对象列表视图自身 sort 排序」)与 17.2.0 实测不符 —— 要么兑现迁移说明(继承路线),要么给新声明位;维持「说明与行为都不成立」最伤。
- **防 AI 写代码犯错** — 迁移说明 declared≠enforced 正是 AI 消费文档时会照抄出错的形状;继承路线零新键、语义可从现有文档推出,新键路线则要同步 spec/引擎/UI 三面,漏一面就是新的半声明。
- **创业阶段不扩散需求** — 继承子对象列表视图 `sort`(兑现既有迁移说明)不新增任何 spec 面;字段级 `relatedListSort` 是新键扩面,仅当继承语义确实不够表达(同一子对象在不同父视图要不同排序)才值得付。

**选项**:1) 派生查询继承子对象列表视图的 `sort`(兑现 17.0.0 迁移说明,零新键);2) 新增字段级 `relatedListSort` 声明位(spec 契约扩面,条款②);3) 两者皆做(继承为默认,字段级覆写)。
**推荐:方向 1** —— 零扩面、兑现已发布的迁移承诺、修复 declared≠enforced;若维护者判「同一子对象不同父上下文需不同排序」是真需求,再走 3 的覆写增量。

os-dev-report

**Route: STOP — the emit point lives wholly in objectui. Zero objectstack-side implementation, no branch, no PR.** Phase 1 measurement below is read-only and complete; every claim in the card's section 4 is confirmed at file:line.

## Ruling honoured

> **Ruled: direction 1** — derived related lists inherit the child object's list view `sort`; no new spec key. This honours the published 17.0.0 migration note (declared becomes enforced). … Field-level `relatedListSort` was NOT approved — do not add a key.

Nothing was added, nothing was edited. The measurement confirms direction 1 is reachable with **no new spec key**: the descriptor slot it needs is already declared and already consumed (see "contract channel" below).

## Measurement map

### (a) Descriptor derivation — **objectui**

- `objectui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/deriveRelatedLists.ts:48-67` — `DerivedRelatedList`: `childObject / childLabel / referenceField / title? / columns? / isOwned / isPrimary`. No `sort`, no `filter`.
- `objectui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/deriveRelatedLists.ts:133-146` — **the emit point.** Builds that descriptor from `fieldDef.relatedList / relatedListTitle / relatedListColumns` only. It iterates the child object defs at `:118` but never reads their views.
- `objectui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx:1052-1057` — call site: `deriveRelatedLists(objectDef, objects, { canRead })`.
- `objectui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx:1955-1978` — second drop point: maps each descriptor into `buildDefaultPageSchema`'s `related` shape, emitting `title / objectName / relationshipField / columns? / icon? / isPrimary?`.
- `objectui/packages/plugin-detail/src/synth/buildDefaultPageSchema.ts:174-188` — the `related` option type has no `sort` member; `:683-690` — `componentNode('record:related_list', …)` forwards `title/objectName/relationshipField/columns/limit/icon` and no sort.

### (b) Query assembly — **objectui**

- `objectui/packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-related-list.tsx:211` — `defaultSort={schema.sort}`. The renderer **already** forwards a block-level `sort`; the channel is open and unfilled on the derived path.
- `objectui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx:251-267` — `normalizeSortSpec`: `'field'` / `'-field'` string or `[{field, order}]` to the array form.
- `objectui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx:519-529` — the assembly, verbatim confirmation of the card: `const orderby = fetchSortField ? [{…}] : defaultSortSpec; if (orderby.length > 0) params.$orderby = orderby;` — no sort in, no `$orderby` out, hence the PK fallback order.
- `objectui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx:383-389` — `windowed = !dataProvided && !!api && effectivePageSize > 0 && dataSource.find && !filterActive`. A derived related list self-fetches, so it **is** windowed by default: an inherited sort would take effect through this exact path.

### (c) Which child list view is "the" list view — **objectstack owns the resolver, already exported and already consumed**

- `objectstack/packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts:4111-4198` — `expandViewContainerWithDiagnostics` / `expandViewContainer`. The item matching the declared default `list` is flagged `isDefault` (`:4146-4150`); with no `list` declared, the first list item takes the flag (`:4147`).
- `objectui/packages/app-shell/src/providers/MetadataProvider.tsx:9` imports it (`from '@objectstack/spec/ui'`), `:413-414` calls it, `:377-378` `if (view.isDefault) bucket.primary = entry`, `:429-431` `if (extra.primary && !obj.list) merged.list = extra.primary`.
- **Answer:** "the" list view is the child object def's `list` after that merge — the `isDefault` expanded list view. Its `sort` is declared at `objectstack/packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts:1470-1486` (union: legacy string `"field desc"` | `[{field, order}]`, with `direction` aliased to `order`).
- **Nothing new needs exporting from objectstack** — resolver and value are already on the objectui side of the boundary.

### Contract channel already open (this is why no new key is needed)

`objectstack/packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts:883-928` — `RecordRelatedListProps.sort`: `z.union([z.string(), z.array(strictObject({ field, order }))]).optional().describe('Sort order for related records')`. Declared, parsed, forwarded by the renderer, consumed by `RelatedList`. Direction 1 only has to *fill* it on the derived path.

### The 17.0.0 prose

- `objectstack/packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts:2487-2494` — the `form.defaultSort` retiredKey text: *"nothing read it: a related list inside a form sorts by its own list view's `sort`."*
- Mirrors: `content/docs/references/ui/view.mdx:284` (generated) and `packages/spec/liveness/view.json:355`.
- Per the ruling, behaviour moves to match the prose, so **no prose edit is needed and none was made.** The published skills do not repeat the claim (`skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md:151-160`, `skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md:316-335` cover prominence / title / columns only), so no published skill text is falsified either.

### Is there ANY objectstack-side slice?

No implementation slice. Everything objectstack owns here is already in place and correct: the default-list-view resolver, the ListView `sort` shape, and the `record:related_list.sort` prop. Confirmed no server/SDK-side related-list query builder exists — `grep` for `relatedListFilter|relatedListColumns` across `packages/runtime/src packages/rest/src packages/objectql/src packages/metadata/src` returns nothing, `packages/console` is a stub (README + CHANGELOG + package.json only), and the only `record:related_list` occurrences in objectstack sources are lint validators, the spec itself, and hand-authored `platform-objects` pages. This matches the recorded #8704 precedent, which already ruled the derivation lives wholly in objectui (`packages/spec/src/data/field.test.ts:596-600`).

The one *optional* objectstack slice, offered for routing rather than taken: mirroring the #8704 pattern, the inheritance rule could be pinned as contract text in `relatedList`'s `.describe()` (as `relatedListFilter` did at `field.zod.ts:1014-1047`, pinned by `field.test.ts:602-608`). That would be a `packages/spec/src/**` diff and therefore the path limb — not started, since the dispatch says stop at zero objectstack implementation when the emit point is objectui.

## Handoff — what the objectui-side fix is

Three edits, no new keys, no spec change:

1. `deriveRelatedLists.ts` — add `sort?` to `DerivedRelatedList` and emit it from the child object def's default list view (`child.list?.sort`), never from a field key. The child def is already in hand at `:118`; no new plumbing.
2. `RecordDetailView.tsx:1955-1978` — carry `sort` onto the `related` entry (`childObjectDef` is already resolved at `:1956`).
3. `buildDefaultPageSchema.ts:174-188` and `:683-690` — add `sort` to the `related` option type and forward it into the `record:related_list` node. Renderer and `RelatedList` need no change.

**Shape caveat for the implementer:** the ListView legacy string form is space-separated `"field desc"` (`view.zod.ts:1470`), while `normalizeSortSpec` (`RelatedList.tsx:258-266`) reads a string as `'field'` / `'-field'`. Copying a legacy string through verbatim would emit `$orderby` on a field literally named `seq_no desc`. The inheritance must normalize the ListView union into the array form, or inherit only the array arm.

The three acceptance pins the dispatch specified all land in objectui: (i) derived query carries `$orderby` from the child list view's `sort`; (ii) child with no list-view sort still emits no `$orderby`; (iii) the view read is the `isDefault` one.

## Out-of-scope findings (searched before filing; no new cards created)

1. **`relatedListFilter` non-consumption** — confirmed as the same gap at the same two lines (`deriveRelatedLists.ts:133-146` emits no `filter`; `RecordDetailView.tsx:1959-1978` forwards none; `buildDefaultPageSchema.ts:683-690` has no `filter`), while the block prop exists (`component.zod.ts:930`) and the spec's contract text binds every consumer. **Already filed: objectui#4664** (open, `pm:queue`). Not fixed, no duplicate card.
2. **This card's objectui half — already filed: objectui#5795** (open, `pm:blocked`, parked here). Its root-cause section matches this measurement exactly.
3. **NEW, covered by neither card:** a declared `record:related_list.sort` is silently dropped whenever the list leaves windowed mode. `windowed` goes false while the client text filter is active (`RelatedList.tsx:383-389`) and the client-mode path returns rows unsorted unless the user clicked a column (`:731-733`, `if (windowed || !sortField) return filteredData;`). So an authored sort stops applying the moment a viewer types in the filter box — pre-existing, affecting the authored prop today, and it will affect the inherited sort identically. **Deliberately not filed:** it lands in objectui on the same file surface objectui#5795 already owns and the PM routes objectui; a third overlapping card risks two agents on one file. Recommend attaching it to objectui#5795 as an acceptance sub-point.

- **The 17.0.0 migration prose stays as written** (`view.zod.ts:2487-2494`, mirrored in view.mdx:284 and liveness/view.json:355): behaviour moves to match it when the objectui leg lands; no prose edit needed or made.

So the parking arrangement inverts: objectui#5795 flipped `pm:blocked` → `pm:queue` this stroke with the full map, the ruling, the legacy-string-sort caveat, and the windowed-mode pre-existing defect relayed onto it (comment posted there). **This card stays `pm:blocked` on objectui#5795** and closes when that lands and the acceptance repro from this body (10/20/30/40) passes.

What I am measuring, against a console booted at the current pin (`.objectui-sha` = `9602dc820450`):
1. Parent object plus child object related by a lookup declaring `relatedList: 'primary'` with `relatedListColumns`; child has `seq_no`; the child's default list view declares `sort` by `seq_no asc`.
2. Four child records created in the order 40 / 10 / 30 / 20.
